description: Carryover fixes + shared foundations every Phase 3 agent/projector needs. MUST land first. (A) three Phase-2 carryover fixes: runtime Postgres read-model bootstrap independent of seed.py, 404-not-500 reads on a missing table / unknown id, and async-mode idempotency so a repeated key replays like sync. (B) the shared agent-scaffolding lib libs/acip-agent-common (uniform per-agent LangGraph graph + AgentRunner Kafka loop + templated-LLM-fallback helper + health app) that FEAT-002's six agents inject into. (C) new config keys the policy/merchant agents need (sanctioned geos, high-value thresholds). Independent of FEAT-002/003/004 at the code level but ordered first because every agent and the projector import these. Reuses acip-common throughout; the bootstrap helper + config keys are additive to acip-common (no new dependency); the agent scaffolding is a NEW workspace lib, not part of acip-common.
steps: FIX A.1 (runtime read-model bootstrap, docs/03 §4): add libs/acip-common/src/acip_common/bootstrap.py with ensure_read_model_schema(postgres_dsn: str) -> bool that opens a psycopg connection (lazy import, best-effort: log + return False on failure) and runs CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS for transactions(id PK, customer_id, amount NUMERIC, status, decision, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()), decisions(transaction_id PK, decision, composite_score NUMERIC, strategy), agent_verdicts(transaction_id, agent, score NUMERIC, decision_hint, PK(transaction_id,agent)), event_journal(event_id PK, transaction_id, event_type, occurred_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()) — columns IDENTICAL to scripts/seed.py (reconcile any drift). Module docstring cites docs/03 §4. Export in __all__. Add libs/acip-common/tests/test_bootstrap.py using a fake psycopg connection/cursor (monkeypatch the lazy import) asserting all four CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS statements are issued and a connection failure returns False without raising.

FIX A.1 wiring: in services/commerce-orchestrator/src/commerce_orchestrator/persistence.py call acip_common.bootstrap.ensure_read_model_schema(postgres_dsn) at the start of persist_decision (before the upserts) so a fresh stack with NO seed still has the tables and persists/serves reads. Keep persist_decision best-effort (DB down -> logs + returns False).

FIX A.2 (404 not 500, docs/06 §1): in services/checkout-api/src/checkout_api/reads.py make PostgresReadModel._fetch catch psycopg.errors.UndefinedTable (missing table) and return None (treated as unknown id -> 404) rather than letting it raise a 500; a genuinely-unknown id already returns None. Keep the fail-closed posture for a real connection/operational error (still raises). Add tests in services/checkout-api/tests/test_checkout.py: (a) unknown id -> 404; (b) missing-table (fake read model raising UndefinedTable, or an integration-style fake) -> 404 not 500, for both GET /v1/transactions/{id} and /explain.

FIX A.3 (async idempotency, phase2-review.md gap): in services/checkout-api/src/checkout_api/main.py make the ASYNC /v1/checkout branch honor idempotency like sync. On a first async request with an idempotency_key, store an idempotency record (StoredDecision with the minted transaction_id and the 202 body {transaction_id, status_url}) via IdempotencyStore.put; on a repeat async key, the existing replay check returns the stored body (same transaction_id, no second txn.created emit, no re-mint). The replay check already runs before the txn.created emit, so moving/adding the async put is the change. Add a test asserting a repeated async idempotency_key returns the SAME transaction_id and the producer.publish mock is called exactly once across two identical async requests.

Add config keys to libs/acip-common/src/acip_common/config.py Settings (defaults so the stack boots with no .env) and mirror in .env.example: POLICY_SANCTIONED_GEOS (default 'XX', parsed comma-separated into list[str] via a field_validator like enabled_method_types, NoDecode-annotated), POLICY_HIGH_VALUE_THRESHOLD (float default 4000.0), MERCHANT_HIGH_VALUE_CHALLENGE (float default 4000.0). These let the policy agent DENY the sanctioned_geo scenario (home_geo 'XX') and the merchant agent force CHALLENGE on high_value_midrisk (amount 4800). Keep existing keys unchanged.

Create libs/acip-agent-common (import name acip_agent_common) as a NEW uv workspace lib depending on acip-common: libs/acip-agent-common/{pyproject.toml, src/acip_agent_common/{__init__,graph,runner,rationale,health}.py, tests/test_graph.py}. graph.py: build the uniform per-agent LangGraph StateGraph (docs/02 §2.2) parse_request -> gather_signals -> score -> reason -> assemble_verdict, where the agent-specific score_fn (representation-slice -> (score, decision_hint, evidence, model_version)) and an optional gather_fn are injected so behavior differs by injection not code (docs/02 §2.2/§3). rationale.py: llm_rationale(settings, system, prompt, trace_id) that POSTs llm-gateway /v1/complete and on ANY failure/timeout returns a TEMPLATED rationale string with degraded=True so the agent never blocks on the LLM (docs/02 §1). runner.py: AgentRunner(agent_name, score_fn, settings) with a run_once(envelope)->publishes agent.verdict.produced and a consume loop over EventConsumer(TXN_EVALUATE, group '<agent>-agents') that filters EventType.TXN_EVALUATE_REQUESTED, parses TxnEvaluateRequestedPayload, runs the graph, builds AgentVerdictProducedPayload{agent, produced_at, verdict}, publishes an EventEnvelope (EventType.AGENT_VERDICT_PRODUCED) to AGENT_VERDICTS keyed by transaction_id, then commits the consumer offset AFTER publish (docs/02 §6). health.py: make_health_app(runner)->FastAPI with GET /healthz ({status:ok}) and GET /readyz (ready once the consumer thread is live) and a lifespan that starts the consumer loop in a daemon thread. tests/test_graph.py: with EventProducer/EventConsumer and llm-gateway mocked, assert the graph produces a Verdict and run_once publishes-then-commits in that order, and that an llm failure yields degraded=True templated rationale. Deps: langgraph==0.2.60, fastapi==0.115.6, uvicorn[standard]==0.34.0, httpx==0.28.1, acip-common.

Workspace wiring: in root pyproject.toml add libs/acip-agent-common as a workspace member (it matches libs/* already) and add acip-agent-common = { workspace = true } to [tool.uv.sources] and to [dependency-groups].dev. Run uv sync so it resolves. (The six agents + graph-projector dirs stay in [tool.uv.workspace].exclude until FEAT-002/FEAT-003 add their pyprojects.)
acceptance_criteria: acip_common.bootstrap.ensure_read_model_schema issues CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS for all four read-model tables with columns identical to scripts/seed.py and returns False (no raise) on a DB failure; a unit test proves it.
orchestrator persist_decision calls ensure_read_model_schema before upserts, so a fresh stack with no seed persists and serves reads.
checkout-api GET /v1/transactions/{id} and /explain return 404 (not 500) for an unknown id AND when a read-model table is missing; tests prove both.
A repeated idempotency_key in ASYNC mode returns the same transaction_id and does not emit a second txn.created or re-mint a transaction; a test proves it.
Settings exposes POLICY_SANCTIONED_GEOS (list), POLICY_HIGH_VALUE_THRESHOLD, MERCHANT_HIGH_VALUE_CHALLENGE with the documented defaults and still loads with no .env.

libs/acip-agent-common is a resolvable uv workspace member exporting the uniform per-agent LangGraph graph, an AgentRunner that publishes agent.verdict.produced to AGENT_VERDICTS and commits AFTER publish, a templated-fallback llm_rationale, and a health app; unit tests pass with Kafka + llm-gateway mocked.
verification: uv run pytest libs/acip-common libs/acip-agent-common services/checkout-api services/commerce-orchestrator  (all pass, incl. new test_bootstrap, the two 404-on-missing-table tests, and the async-idempotency replay test)
uv run mypy libs services  (clean, strict)
findings:
DONE. Full gate green: uv sync; 48 tests pass (libs/acip-common incl test_bootstrap, libs/acip-agent-common test_agent_scaffolding, services/checkout-api incl both missing-table 404 tests + async-idempotency replay, services/commerce-orchestrator); ruff/black/mypy strict clean (61 source files).

=== acip-common additions (import, never redefine) ===
bootstrap: acip_common.bootstrap.ensure_read_model_schema(postgres_dsn: str) -> bool. Lazy psycopg import; issues CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS for transactions/decisions/agent_verdicts/event_journal (columns identical to scripts/seed.py); best-effort -> returns False (never raises) on failure. Called at the START of commerce_orchestrator.persistence.persist_decision before upserts.
Settings new attrs (defaults so stack boots with no .env; mirrored in .env.example): policy_sanctioned_geos: list[str] (alias POLICY_SANCTIONED_GEOS, NoDecode + field_validator comma-split, default ['XX']); policy_high_value_threshold: float (alias POLICY_HIGH_VALUE_THRESHOLD, default 4000.0); merchant_high_value_challenge: float (alias MERCHANT_HIGH_VALUE_CHALLENGE, default 4000.0).

=== NEW lib libs/acip-agent-common (import name acip_agent_common) ===
Workspace-wired: root pyproject [tool.uv.sources] acip-agent-common={workspace=true}, added to [dependency-groups].dev, and ruff src list. Its pyproject declares acip-common={workspace=true}; deps langgraph==0.2.60, fastapi==0.115.6, uvicorn[standard]==0.34.0, httpx==0.28.1.

MODULES / PUBLIC API the six agents (FEAT-002) inject into:
- graph.ScoreResult (dataclass): score: float, decision_hint: DecisionHint, model_version: str, evidence: list[Evidence]=[], confidence: float=1.0.
- graph.ScoreFn = Callable[[SharedRepresentation, dict[str, Any]], ScoreResult]  (the ONLY per-agent variation).
- graph.GatherFn = Callable[[SharedRepresentation], dict[str, Any]]  (optional signal slice; defaults to no-op).
- graph.build_agent_graph() -> compiled LangGraph (nodes parse_request->gather_signals->score->reason->assemble_verdict; stateless; score_fn/gather_fn/settings/agent_name passed via config['configurable'] at run time). NOTE: internal state key is 'agent_score' (not 'score') because LangGraph forbids a node name matching a state channel key.
- graph.run_agent_graph(*, compiled, agent_name: str, score_fn: ScoreFn, settings: Settings, payload: dict, trace_id: str, gather_fn: GatherFn|None=None) -> AgentGraphResult(verdict: Verdict, representation: SharedRepresentation). payload is the raw TxnEvaluateRequestedPayload dict off the inbound envelope.
- rationale.llm_rationale(settings: Settings, *, system: str, prompt: str, trace_id: str) -> RationaleResult(text: str, degraded: bool). POSTs {system,prompt,metadata:{trace_id}} to {settings.llm_gateway_url}/v1/complete (3s timeout); ANY failure/timeout/non-2xx/empty-text -> templated string + degraded=True so the agent never blocks on the LLM.
- runner.AgentRunner(agent_name: AgentName, score_fn: ScoreFn, settings: Settings, *, gather_fn: GatherFn|None=None, producer: EventProducer|None=None, consumer: EventConsumer|None=None, compiled: Any|None=None). .running property. Default consumer group = f'{agent_name.value}-agents' on topic TXN_EVALUATE. Default producer -> settings.kafka_bootstrap.
  * run_once(envelope: EventEnvelope) -> Verdict: runs graph, builds AgentVerdictProducedPayload{agent, produced_at, verdict}, publishes an EventEnvelope (EventType.AGENT_VERDICT_PRODUCED, producer=f'{agent}-agent') to AGENT_VERDICTS keyed by transaction_id, flushes. Does NOT commit.
  * consume_forever(poll_timeout=1.0): streams TXN_EVALUATE, filters EventType.TXN_EVALUATE_REQUESTED, calls run_once, then consumer.commit() AFTER publish (docs/02 §6). On run_once failure it does NOT commit (offset replays). PUBLISH-THEN-COMMIT contract is asserted by a test (event order ['publish','commit']).
  * close() closes the consumer.
- health.make_health_app(runner: AgentRunner) -> FastAPI: GET /healthz -> {status: ok}; GET /readyz -> {status: ready} once runner.running (else 503); lifespan starts runner.consume_forever in a daemon thread named f'{agent}-consume' and calls runner.close() on shutdown.
Top-level package exports (acip_agent_common.__init__): AgentGraphResult, AgentRunner, GatherFn, ScoreFn, ScoreResult, build_agent_graph, llm_rationale, make_health_app.

=== carryover fixes ===
- checkout_api.reads.PostgresReadModel._fetch now wraps the psycopg block in try/except psycopg.errors.UndefinedTable -> returns None (missing table => unknown id => 404). Real connection/operational errors still raise (500). Both GET /v1/transactions/{id} and /explain tested for 404 on unknown id and missing table.
- checkout_api.main async branch: on a first async request with idempotency_key it now idempotency.put(StoredDecision(txn_id, 202-body)); the existing top-of-handler replay check returns the stored body on a repeat key, so a repeated async key replays the SAME transaction_id with txn.created emitted exactly once (tested).

NOTE for later FEATs: the agent test module is libs/acip-agent-common/tests/test_agent_scaffolding.py (NOT test_graph.py and NO tests/__init__.py) to avoid a top-level pytest module-name clash with services/commerce-orchestrator/tests/test_graph.py. Keep per-service/lib test module names unique and leave service/lib test dirs without __init__.py (matches the existing service convention).
